title: Attack Aura Without Players
features: just attacks the trees and stuff idk
script:
_G.Aura = not _G.Aura

local Range = 50

while _G.Aura and task.wait(.1) do
    for _,Knife in game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Weapon:GetChildren() do
        if not Knife:IsA("Model") then continue end
        for i,v in workspace.Item:GetChildren() do
            local dist = (game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - v.PrimaryPart.Position).Magnitude

            if dist >= Range then continue end

            firetouchinterest(v.PrimaryPart, Knife.PrimaryPart, 0)
            firetouchinterest(v.PrimaryPart, Knife.PrimaryPart, 1)
        end
    end
end
